label: r13
rationale: A2-0650 passes every development guard, the larger multilingual mean and every larger individual guard. English macro WER alone remains 0.012449 points above the original. Test a short English-emphasized continuation: 80% original mixture plus 20% original English CV/FLEURS group, preserving all training membership. Retain R11/R12 teacher coefficients, halve every peak learning rate, and use a fresh 300-step cosine schedule with 10 warmup steps and seed 20260910. All 651 remaining parameter tensors train; exact Gabor functions and BN running statistics stay fixed. This is adaptive recovery on exposed regressions, not independent validation.
selection_rule: Audit and evaluate all three declared exports. Run development-passing exports on the larger regression in increasing development-WER order, stopping at the first full pass. If none passes development, evaluate the lowest-development-WER export once for diagnosis. Record all results and explicitly name larger comparisons not run.
